experiment.topic: Gap-down quality in BTC-USD: 30-hour mean reversion probability after 2% gap-down events
experiment.hypothesis: After a 2% gap-down event in BTC-USD, price exhibits a 30-hour mean reversion with a 90% probability of returning to within 5% of the pre-gap level, indicating liquidity-driven reversion rather than a structural shift.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For each BTC-USD gap-down event exceeding 2% in price, compute the 30-hour return; if the 30-hour return is greater than or equal to 5%, the hypothesis is falsified; if all such events have 30-hour returns below 5%, the hypothesis is supported.
